content: Anti-AI-Slop UI/UX Rules: NEVER generate generic AI UI (no purple gradients, no lorem ipsum). ALWAYS use shadcn/ui or Radix UI for accessibility. Spacing: Use 4px/8px grid (p-4, gap-2, space-y-4). Typography: Max 2 fonts (Inter or Geist). States: Every component MUST have Loading, Empty, and Error states. Accessibility: aria-labels, focus-visible rings, contrast > 4.5:1. Responsive: Mobile-first (flex-col, md:flex-row). Micro-interactions: hover:scale-105, transition-all, active:scale-95.
